metrics.label: Profit after tax including share of associates and joint ventures

change: Higher crude and fuel prices lifted sales in Reliance’s fuels and chemicals business. The group also reported higher profit.
watch: Watch whether the fuels business earns more after paying for crude, even if fuel prices lift sales.

sources.label: Official September quarter results
sources.location: Consolidated financial performance for Q2 FY27 and Q2 FY26, rows 1 and 10, and Consolidated Reported Results, fuels and chemicals commentary. Profit includes the share of associates and joint ventures.
